text.content:
Trigger: Leaving a familiar, controlled space, or entering a situation from which escape would be difficult or embarrassing.

Called "Mad Scientist's Disease" by younger @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}, agoraphobia manifests as an extreme aversion to places the sufferer fears will trigger a panic. Sometimes the fear attaches to a few specific locations; generalized agoraphobics avoid any situation in which escape is difficult (an airplane at cruising altitude) or embarrassing (giving a speech). The territorial nature of many Tzimisce makes this derangement relatively common within the clan — no doubt the world holds at least a handful of agoraphobic Cainites driven into torpor from lack of blood rather than leave their havens.

Unless supernaturally compelled, an agoraphobic vampire must succeed on a Willpower roll (difficulty 8) to leave her haven each evening, and must spend a point of Willpower to enter a situation from which escape would be difficult or embarrassing. Failing any Willpower roll during a scene set in such a situation forces the character to spend a point of Willpower or flee. Vampires can ignore these constraints while in frenzy.

vtmlarp.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
